title: Alpha-compact class core with representatives of P
statement: For an essentially v-small class P in the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with coproducts [lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts], there are a regular alpha in universe v and a class S exactly equal to the alpha-compact objects [def-sfb-alpha-compact-object]. S is essentially v-small, replete, triangulated and closed under coproducts indexed by types of cardinality less than alpha. Every member of S and every member of P is alpha-compact.

source.place: Ambient well-generation and common cardinal bound: Neeman Theorem 0.2; Krause Localization theory Sections 6.2--6.3.

proof.text: Use eventual smallness of the canonical classes and ranks for every object. Choose a small representative set for P and a common regular bound above their ranks and the eventual bound.

Take S to be the canonical alpha-compact class. Use its proved repletion, zero, shift and bounded coproduct APIs together with the bounded-class extension theorem to give the triangulated instance. Transport each representative rank along its isomorphism to include P.

proof_origin.place: Source-correct alpha-compactness, Krause (2001) G3/G4, Lemmas 4--5; Neeman Theorem 0.2.

statement_change.old_statement: For an essentially v-small class P in the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category, there are an object property S and a regular cardinal alpha in universe v such that S is exactly the alpha-presentable objects, S is essentially v-small, replete and triangulated, is closed under coproducts indexed by types of cardinality less than alpha, every object of S is alpha-presentable, and every object of P is alpha-presentable.
statement_change.what: The source defines alpha-compactness by alpha-smallness and coproduct factorization G4, not ordinary IsCardinalPresentable in the triangulated category. The old ordinary-presentable theorem is not established by this repair; replace that erroneous interface by the actual source notion, with all consumers adapted in the same delivery. This restores the source proof without weakening the unchanged final perfect-class theorem.

source.place: Krause (2001) pages 121--125, alpha-small objects and maximal G4 class; Localization theory 6.3 and 6.10.2 distinguish this from presentability in the abelianization.

citers.note: The downstream perfect-class conclusion is unchanged. The Core/Properties interfaces are adapted together to the actual maximal alpha-compact class; no target statement or target-used definition changes.

old_proof.text: Choose a regular cardinal above the well-generation bound and above compactness ranks of representatives of P. Let S be the alpha-compact objects. Well-generation and localization give essential smallness, repleteness, triangulated closure, and closure under coproducts of fewer than alpha summands; alpha-presentability is the defining property, and the cardinal bound makes every member of P alpha-presentable.
